enunciado: The abstract class Drink defines prepare() with fixed steps (boil water, brew, serve) and steps each subclass customizes (brew, addExtras). Implement Coffee and Tea and prepare both.
objetivos: Fix the skeleton of an algorithm in the parent class
Let subclasses fill in the variable steps
pistas: prepare() calls the other methods in order.
Common steps are implemented only once in Drink.
addExtras can have a default version that does nothing.
